full_name: Héctor Tobar | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Journalism & Nonfiction Lillian Gollay Knafel Fellow University of California, Irvine
bio: Héctor Tobar is a novelist and journalist and the author of five books. He is currently an associate professor of literary journalism and Chicano/Latino studies at the University of California, Irvine.
